label: Staka
comment: Cretan staka and staka butter: cream cooked with flour splits into protein paste and fat.
note: Cretan, from cream; a roux-like paste of protein and flour, eaten hot with bread

about.text: Staka is a Cretan speciality made by cooking sheep or goat cream with a little flour over low heat. The protein-rich part sets with the flour into staka, a thick white paste eaten hot with bread or in pies and pilaf.

facts.v: the protein with the flour coagulates (staka); the melted fat separates (stakovoutiro)
